beat + breath™ facilitator certification and affiliate program. Calm they can take home.

Give your clients a way to find calm on their own, between sessions.

Your clients come in with anxiety and low mood and want something practical to do between sessions. Our courses give them breath practices they can use at home, from a three minute method set to music to concrete breaths for moments of high stress. Share your code with them and they save on enrolment. Every course has a continuing education option for you too. If you want to teach the method yourself, our one day BEAT + BREATH™ Certification shows you how.

Led by Esther Kalaba, MA, RP, co-creator of BEAT + BREATH™ with composer Ma’amo Koba.

who it’s for.

For the people who hold everyone else steady.

You know the conversation. A client tells you about the anxiety, the low mood, the sleepless nights, and you talk it through together. Next week it’s back. Talking helps them understand what’s happening, but it doesn’t change how their body reacts at 3 a.m. They need something they can do on their own, and you need a simple way to teach it.

  • Psychotherapists and counsellors
  • Yoga and meditation teachers
  • Educators and school staff
  • Health care professionals
  • Corporate wellness facilitators
  • Community leaders and trainers

This training is for you if

  • You work with stressed, anxious or overwhelmed people.
  • You want to give clients a tool they can use without you, not another conversation.
  • You need something easy to teach and easy to practice.
  • You’re tired of techniques that sound good but don’t hold up in real sessions.
  • You want to bring breathwork into a clinical setting but don’t know how.
Apply for the waitlist

two sessions, six hours.

What you’ll learn.

One day, two live sessions, 6 hours in all, online or in person. You leave knowing how to teach BEAT + BREATH™, not just how to practice it.

  1. Session 1

    Breath Foundationsunderstand and practice

    • Why breath matters for mental health, and how stress disrupts breathing.
    • The link between breath and feeling safe, and the basics of breathing physiology.
    • Diaphragmatic breathing and a healthy inhale and exhale.
    • How to spot breath patterns that feed stress.
    • Guided practices you can teach others.
  2. Session 2

    The BEAT + BREATH™ Methodlearn to teach it

    • The core components of the method.
    • Why rhythm and counting calm the nervous system.
    • How to teach it, step by step.
    • How to adapt it for different settings and people.
    • Clinical, educational and workplace applications.

the path to certification.

Six steps after the training.

Certification is earned through practice, so you teach from your own experience of the breath, not from a script.

  1. 1. Practice.

    22.5 hours of personal practice, 15 minutes a session.

  2. 2. Reflect.

    Keep a reflective journal on your own breath journey.

  3. 3. Teach.

    Teach at least 10 sessions, one on one or in groups.

  4. 4. Write the exam.

    Pass the online written exam.

  5. 5. Be evaluated.

    A teaching evaluation, live or recorded.

  6. 6. Share a case.

    One written case study from your teaching.

once you’re certified.

Bring calm into the rooms where you work.

Picture ending a session by breathing with your client for three minutes, then sending them home with tracks they can press play on that night. The next week, they tell you what happened when they used it.

What you can do

  • Offer the method to your clients, students or staff.
  • Build it into therapy, education, health care or workplace programs.
  • Use the official audio tracks, worksheets and teaching resources in your professional work.
  • Earn a 20% affiliate commission when you refer the program. Corporate licensing packages are available.
  • Collaborate and teach with People of the Prana.

What you receive

  • An official certificate and facilitator badge.
  • An individual practitioner licence, within the usage guidelines.
  • A place in the People of the Prana alumni community.
  • Ongoing discounts on future trainings and courses.
  • A listing in the alumni directory, for referrals.

why it works.

Simple enough to teach. Grounded enough to trust.

continuing education.

Looking for CE credits instead?

You can earn continuing education credits with Begin with Breath and the Nervous System First Aid Kit. Take the course like everyone else, then write a short exam afterward if you want to receive CE credits. These courses are for your own learning and practice; they don’t certify you to teach them.

a word from Esther.

“I want every helper to have this.”

I see so many people on the edge of burnout, doing the most important work in the world. In all the training programs I have come across, I have never seen an emphasis on anything that strengthens the nervous system of the helper.

Breathing takes almost no time, and it goes everywhere you go. When you can stay calm in a difficult situation, you can do your job better, and you feel better doing it. Teaching BEAT + BREATH™ lets you pass that on to the people you serve.

with gratitude,Esther Kalaba, MA, RPCo-founder, People of the Prana
